title: Hatsune Miku — Feeling Down, Down, Down〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is everything okay, Miku?
You seem really worried about something but haven't said a word.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, is this about Birdie...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I was trying to think of a way for us to put on a show together that isn't dangerous...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I thought really, really hard, but haven't been able to come up with anything good!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It won't be easy since their show requires others to fly.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But if we try to make it safe, it'll likely end up not being the show they wanted to do...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And that's the biggest problem.
Isn't there a clever way for us to quickly resolve this issue...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That sounds difficult... It's like when you have to choose between covers or a pillow...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, huh? O-Okay...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, this is nothing like that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, let's take this opportunity to brainstorm together and figure out a way for us to put on a show with our feathery friend!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
Let's do our best, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
W-Wow!
We came up with so many ideas!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: KAITO, what do you think?! Will we be able to do a show with Birdie now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Well...
We came up with every idea that we could.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yours in particular seemed especially good, Miku. Using wires may be the closest we'll ever get to what Birdie originally wanted.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, let's tell them what we came up with.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We did it, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Thank you for helping, MEIKO, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? You both seem a little unsatisfied.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry!
I didn't mean to look so gloomy! I know this isn't the right time!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But please try to remember what Birdie actually wanted, Miku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Our ideas allow us to take a step closer to their original plan, but it's still not what they were hoping for...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
None of us said that we should jump around on top of the flying train...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I still wanna do a show with Birdie.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wanna tell Birdie that we all want to, and that we really mean it...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, Miku, go.
Our thoughts are in your hands.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay☆ I'll be back!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Where'd Birdie go...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... Aha!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
“Flap-flap-jump-jump!
Straight through the donut!”

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: No, there has to be a better way to show how much fun it is to fly... A cooler way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Birdie's really all alone...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
“Flap-flap-jump-jump!
Straight through the donut!” Ow!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: That was close. I'd have a big bump on my head right now if I weren't a plushie.

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
*Sob*
If only someone would help me...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Bird...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: No! Now's not the time for that!!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
I said I'm gonna do this show!
And only I can do it because it's too dangerous for the others!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
I have to do it!
I have to show everyone just how much fun it is to fly!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: It's so sad that only I know what it's like to fly. So, I'm gonna show everyone how great it is!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: I wanna show them how great it feels to rip through the air! I wanna tell them about how fun it is when you become so light as you fly really high into the air!

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna keep trying that last part until I succeed!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Birdie...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Now I see... Birdie wants to pull off those stunts no matter what.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm not sure I should say anything right now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As worried as I am, I kinda want to see Birdie's show...

rows.Speaker: Birdie Plushie
rows.Line:
“Flap-flap-jump-jump!
Straight through the donut!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Good luck, Birdie!
I'll be back a little later...
